title: fw-wan VPNs
description: fw-wan's IPsec connections, VTI and WireGuard interfaces, WireGuard peers, BGP over the tunnels.

panels.title: IPsec connections
panels.description: IKE SA established per configured connection.

panels.title: IKE state
panels.description: strongSwan's IKE SA state (CONNECTING while it keeps retrying an unreachable peer).

panels.title: WireGuard peers
panels.description: UP = handshake within the last 3 minutes. Road-warrior peers are DOWN while not connected.

panels.title: BGP sessions
panels.description: BGP sessions reported by frr_exporter (underlay IPv6 unicast, EVPN to the spines, external peerings). A router whose exporter is down drops out of the total.

panels.title: vpn-metrics.py
panels.description: The textfile script could read IPsec (VICI) and WireGuard state, and how old its output is (it runs every minute).

panels.title: SA age
panels.description: Since the IKE SA was established and the newest CHILD SA installed (rekeys replace the CHILD SA).

panels.title: Rekeys in range
panels.description: How often the SA age went back to 0: rekeys and re-establishments (a CHILD rekey every few hours is normal).

panels.title: CHILD SA traffic
panels.description: Decrypted traffic through each CHILD SA (counters restart at a rekey; rate() handles that).

panels.title: Errors and drops
panels.description: A VTI counts tx errors when it has no CHILD SA to send through (tunnel down).

panels.title: Link state
panels.description: From VyOS (Telegraf show_interfaces): admin down = disabled in the config.

targets.expr: max by (interface) (show_interfaces_link{host="fw-wan", interface=~"vti.*|wg.*"}) + max by (interface) (show_interfaces_state{host="fw-wan", interface=~"vti.*|wg.*"})

panels.title: Tunnel interfaces
panels.description: VRF and tunnel from the config snapshot. Rates over the last 5 minutes.

targets.expr: max by (interface) (show_interfaces_link{host="fw-wan", interface=~"vti.*|wg.*"} + on (interface) show_interfaces_state{host="fw-wan", interface=~"vti.*|wg.*"})

panels.title: Last handshake
panels.description: Age of the latest handshake per peer (WireGuard re-handshakes every 2 minutes while traffic flows).

panels.title: BGP peers
panels.description: One row per session (VRF, address family, peer). Interface peers (eth1.1000/eth2.1000 on fw-wan) are BGP unnumbered; the hostname comes from the peer's BGP hostname capability.

targets.expr: max without (instance, job, role, host) (frr_bgp_peer_state{host="fw-wan", vrf=~"vpn_.*"})
max without (instance, job, role, host) (frr_bgp_peer_uptime_seconds{host="fw-wan", vrf=~"vpn_.*"})
max without (instance, job, role, host) (frr_bgp_peer_prefixes_received_count_total{host="fw-wan", vrf=~"vpn_.*"})
max without (instance, job, role, host) (frr_bgp_peer_prefixes_advertised_count_total{host="fw-wan", vrf=~"vpn_.*"})
max without (instance, job, role, host) (rate(frr_bgp_peer_message_received_total{host="fw-wan", vrf=~"vpn_.*"}[5m]) + rate(frr_bgp_peer_message_sent_total{host="fw-wan", vrf=~"vpn_.*"}[5m]))
max without (instance, job, role, host) (resets(frr_bgp_peer_uptime_seconds{host="fw-wan", vrf=~"vpn_.*"}[$__range]))
max without (instance, job, role, local_as, peer_as, peer_hostname, peer_desc, peer_type) (frr_bgp_peer_state{host="fw-wan", vrf=~"vpn_.*"})

panels.title: Matches per chain
panels.description: ipsec (IKE/ESP to fw-wan, input filter 500-502), haystack* (forwarded from vpn_hay), vpn_me_FW (from vpn_me), wg70_fw and bgp_peers.

panels.title: Drops and rejects
panels.description: ipsec default-action: IKE/ESP from addresses that aren't configured peers.

targets.expr: sum by (chain, ruleid) ((label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_join(label_replace(rate(nftables_pkts{host="fw-wan", chain=~"NAME_(ipsec|haystack.*|vpn_me_FW|wg70_fw|bgp_peers)"}[$__rate_interval]), "chain", "$1", "chain", "NAME_(.+)"), "rule", "/", "chain", "ruleid"), "action", "unknown", "rule", ".*"), "action", "accept", "rule", "bgp_peers/1|bgp_peers/2|bgp_peers/3|conn_filter/10|deny_guest_vrf/5|deny_guest_vrf/10|dns_in/1|dns_in/2|dns_in/3|haystack/4|haystack/5|haystack/6|haystack/60|haystack/179|haystack/180|haystack/190|haystack/3000|haystack_dns/1|haystack_dns/2|haystack_dns/3|haystack_ssh/1|haystack_ssh/2|haystack_ssh/3|haystack_vxlan/1|haystack_vxlan/100|ipsec/1|ipsec/2|lylat_lan_forward/default-action|vpn_me_FW/1|vpn_me_FW/22|vpn_me_FW/100|vpn_me_FW/101|vyos_mgmt/22|vyos_mgmt/23"), "action", "drop", "rule", "bgp_peers/default-action|conn_filter/20|deny_data/22|deny_data/23|deny_data/24|deny_guest_vrf/9|deny_guest_vrf/default-action|haystack/2|ipsec/default-action|outside-in/default-action|vpn_me_FW/default-action|wg70_fw/default-action"), "action", "jump", "rule", "haystack/22|haystack/53|haystack/100|wg70_fw/10|wg70_fw/53"), "action", "reject", "rule", "dns_in/default-action|haystack/3|haystack/default-action|haystack_dns/default-action|haystack_ssh/default-action|haystack_vxlan/default-action"), "action", "return", "rule", "conn_filter/default-action|deny_data/default-action|vyos_mgmt/default-action")) and on (action) (label_replace(vector(1), "action", "drop", "__name__", ".*") or label_replace(vector(1), "action", "reject", "__name__", ".*")))

panels.title: charon
panels.description: strongSwan's log lines from the syslog (InfluxDB), newest first.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "vyos")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "syslog" and r._field == "message" and r.host == "fw-wan")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.appname =~ /charon/)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, Severity: r.severity, App: r.appname, Message: r._value}))
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 300)
